blocks: 1. Sign in to ShopView with a role that can open Reports (for example an administrator).
2. In the top navigation bar, click "Reports".
3. In the left-hand report menu, under the "PARTS" heading, click "Parts Velocity"; the report opens with a row of filter chips across the top (Date, Type, Category, Vendor, Bin, Location).
4. Choose a shop and a date range that have parts data, so the report shows rows.

blocks: 1. Set a non-default view: click the "Type" chip and choose "Inventory"; click the "Date" chip and choose "Last Month"; click the "Category" chip and pick one category; click the columns button (the grid icon at the top-right of the table) and switch on the "Turns / Yr" column; then click the "Revenue" column header until the rows sort by Revenue, highest first.
2. Leave the report: in the left-hand menu click another report (for example "Inventory Value"), then click "Parts Velocity" again to come back.
3. Reload the page in the browser (press F5) and look at the report again.
